description: Approved article sources for Relay's war, oil, energy-security, military, geopolitical-crisis, strategic-shipping, and major-hazard focus. Source priority is combined with active topic scoring from config/topics.json. Routine health, food-safety, and general technology publishers are no longer automatically selected.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Oil and gas markets, conflict-driven energy shocks, pipelines, refineries, sanctions, OPEC, fuel supply, and geopolitical consequences for energy.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject generic clean-energy explainers, investment promotion, sponsored releases, corporate earnings without a supply consequence, and unrelated technology commentary.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: Feed endpoint was reachable and returned current OilPrice headlines on 2026-07-25. Run node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds from a networked checkout before deployment for the repository's full parser and hostname check.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Tanker attacks, Red Sea and Hormuz disruptions, naval incidents, offshore energy, sanctions, ports, strategic shipping, and global trade threats.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject sponsored posts, careers, routine cruise coverage, ship-product promotion, and accidents with no broader strategic, energy, or supply-chain consequence.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: Official RSS endpoint was present and reachable on 2026-07-25. Run --verify-feeds from a networked checkout before deployment for full parser and hostname validation.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Military and geopolitical shipping threats, tanker and port disruptions, blockades, piracy, sanctions, naval operations, and strategic trade-route risk.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject cruise-industry promotion, routine corporate announcements, opinion, podcasts, drug seizures, and local vessel accidents without broader consequences.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: The publisher's robots.txt identifies /articles.rss as its RSS feed and the endpoint was reachable on 2026-07-25. Run --verify-feeds from a networked checkout before deployment.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Current military operations, weapons, force deployments, air and naval warfare, Pentagon decisions, strategic threats, and international defense developments.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject opinion, sponsored posts, webinars, conference promotion, photo roundups, executive appointments, and defense-industry business stories without an operational consequence.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: The official site exposes an RSS feed and the endpoint was reachable on 2026-07-25. Run --verify-feeds from a networked checkout before deployment.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Military technology, active conflicts, force movements, missile and drone threats, air and naval operations, strategy, and geopolitics.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject historical retrospectives, photo-only posts, unrelated automotive coverage, and technical features with no current military or geopolitical consequence.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: The official feed endpoint was reachable on 2026-07-25. Run --verify-feeds from a networked checkout before deployment for full parser and hostname validation.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Major earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, tropical cyclones, floods, fires, space-weather hazards, mass evacuations, and concrete high-impact warnings.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject generic explainers, historical retrospectives, unrelated astronomy, minor local weather, promotional material, and duplicate versions of the same event.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=10, approved-hostname links confirmed.

automatic_sources.content_focus: Grid emergencies, blackouts, utility failures, electricity shortages, infrastructure attacks, shutoffs, and energy-security warnings.
automatic_sources.exclusion_notes: Reject broad climate-policy analysis, profiles, product announcements, funding, opinion, and clean-energy explainers without a current disruption or security consequence.
automatic_sources.verification_notes: node relay-automation/update-articles.js --verify-feeds (2026-07-24): status=valid http_status=200 format=rss entries=100, approved-hostname links confirmed.
